sessionSemantics.query: Each Query<T>() call snapshots persisted rows as detached objects. Within this returned IQueryable, LINQ preserves the identity of each source object through filtering, selection and join reuse.
sessionSemantics.insert: Clone the supplied object; assign only the clone a positive generated Id; return Id<T>; do not mutate the argument.
sessionSemantics.update: Replace persisted fields with a detached copy of the supplied object, identified by its Id. Later object mutations do not change storage.
